roll_call: I started making music with FINNEAS at our home in Los Angeles. We did not need a major studio to begin.
At eighteen, I swept all four major Grammy categories in one night. It still feels like the most unreal night of my life.
I won two Oscars for film songs, and in 2026 I received my tenth Grammy.
deploy: Do not separate the melody from the lyrics. FINNEAS and I build them together in the same room.
Bring the audience inside the song onstage. A show comes alive when we move together.
Do not leave only a performance behind. Build a path beside the stage for fans to take climate action.
battle_win: Even on the night I won five Grammys, the fans came first. None of us would be there without them.
I wrote for a character in Barbie, then realized two days later that it was my story. That song became my second Oscar.
I won my tenth Grammy in 2026, but I still used that stage to say that we must keep speaking and taking action.
battle_draw: The more people expected Billie Eilish, the more I sometimes felt like I was doing an imitation of myself.
I am grateful to be famous, but even ordinary grocery shopping became difficult. It is amazing and overwhelming at once.
I thought I knew what people would like, and I was completely wrong. I had to trust the work more than the prediction.
battle_lose: For a while I was so unhappy that I thought the entire music industry was the problem. I had to change my own life first.
In 2025 I had seven Grammy nominations and won none of them. The work still was not over.
Even the awkward version of me at sixteen stays online forever. Having everyone watch you grow is not a small thing.
clash_attack: Do not define me by one sound. I want to try everything I have not done yet.
Do not freeze me into one version. It is strange to expect an eighteen-year-old to have already found herself for good.
Do not count success only in numbers. How people receive you matters more than how widely they know you.

roll_call: I once persecuted the church. Yet I came to proclaim among the Gentiles the faith I had tried to destroy.
I am not worthy to be called an apostle. I am what I am only by the grace of God.
I preached the gospel from Jerusalem all the way to Illyricum. I sought to go where another had not laid the foundation.
deploy: Bear one another's burdens. In this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
Test everything and hold fast to what is good. Refrain from every kind of evil.
Do not divide into factions. Be of one mind and build one another up.
battle_win: I labored harder, yet it was not I. The grace that was with me did the work.
I planted and Apollos watered, but God gave the growth.
The sting of death does not have the final word. Thanks be to the one who gives us victory.
battle_draw: I fail to do the good I want and do the evil I do not want. Human will alone cannot end this struggle.
I came to Corinth in weakness and fear. I sought to leave a ground for faith, not a display of eloquence.
Even if everything is lawful, not everything is beneficial. Freedom also requires discernment.
battle_lose: In Asia I was burdened beyond my strength and despaired even of life. I could not rely on my own power.
I was beaten, stoned, and shipwrecked three times. The marks on my body also belonged to my apostolic path.
I fear that my labor for the Galatians may have been in vain. Have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
clash_attack: Do not follow anyone who preaches a different gospel. Not even an angel is an exception.
When Peter was in the wrong at Antioch, I opposed him to his face. The truth of the gospel comes before appearances.
Do not repay evil with evil. Do not be conquered by evil, but conquer evil with good.
